1.title: Model Refusals Don't Stop Hackers | Devon Thomas
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Devon Thomas (Abliteration CEO) discusses selling unrestricted cybersecurity models, red teaming AI agents, and argues that model refusals handicap cyber defenders; touches on open vs closed model tradeoffs and frontier weight release policy.

1.title: A mind-expanding conversation on how models actually work | Emmanuel Ameisen (Anthropic)
1.author: Lenny's Podcast
1.hook: Interpretability researcher at Anthropic walks through how LLMs actually plan ahead, form concept representations, and exhibit planning multiple tokens in advance—covering the gap between "next-token predictor" framing and what models actually do; includes specific findings on the "J space," scaling laws, and alignment implications.

2.title: How Medical Practices Beat Insurance Denials | Xavier De Gracia
2.author: MTS
2.hook: Xavier De Gracia (Prosper AI) on how AI agents recover revenue in specialty medical practices — $108B annual losses from missed calls/billing errors, $125k recovery per physician claimed; covers agent design, practice economics, insurer vs provider AI dynamics.

3.title: We Built an AI CFO to Help You Grow Your Net Worth | Anthony Pompliano
3.author: Peter Yang
3.hook: Conversation with Anthony Pompliano on building Silvia, an AI CFO for independent investors; covers audience-as-deal-flow, hiring for revenue, and a specific tax optimization case ($100K/year). Also touches on small teams competing with AI labs, and Pompliano's career philosophy.
